Buffer.fromUTF8: Create a new buffer from an UTF8-encoded string
Buffer.toString: Convert a buffer to string assuming UTF8 encoding
butia.motorStopSingle: Stops a single motor, leaving the other running.
butia.motorTank: Sets each motor's speed independently (tank drive).
butia.moveBackward: Drives both motors backward. Runs indefinitely, or for the given duration if set.
butia.moveForward: Drives both motors forward. Runs indefinitely, or for the given duration if set.
butia.obstacleDistance: Reads the distance sensor on the given connector, in cm.
butia.onButton: Runs the handler when the button on the given connector reaches the given state, at the given priority.
butia.onDistance: Runs the handler when the distance sensor on the given connector matches the comparison, at the given priority.
butia.onGray: Runs the handler when the gray sensor on the given connector matches the comparison, at the given priority.
butia.onLight: Runs the handler when the light sensor on the given connector matches the comparison, at the given priority.
butia.readButton: Whether the button on the given connector is currently pressed.
butia.readGenericSensor: Reads a generic analog sensor. Pick an existing name or create one from the dropdown.
butia.readGraySensor: Reads the analog gray/line sensor on the given connector (0-100, higher = darker).
butia.readLightSensor: Reads the light sensor on the given connector (0-100).
butia.servoSetAngle: Sets a servo's angle on the given connector.
butia.startRobot:
Selects which Butia hardware model is active and which botsim map to
run against. Place this block at the beginning of your "on start"
block, before any other motor/sensor block — MakeCode does not insert
it there automatically.
butia.turn: Turns in place toward the given direction.
